summary: Graviton (ARM) CPU inference routing is implemented for pytorch and tensorflow. Changes: src/sagemaker/fw_utils.py adds GRAVITON_ALLOWED_TARGET_INSTANCE_FAMILY (c6g, t4g, r6g, m6g) and GRAVITON_ALLOWED_FRAMEWORKS (pytorch, tensorflow). src/sagemaker/image_uris.py adds the private helper _image_scope_for_instance_type, which runs before config loading, skips routing when accelerator_type is set, and applies the -sagemaker suffix only to the <framework>-inference-graviton repository. src/sagemaker/image_uri_config/pytorch.json and tensorflow.json each gain one inference_graviton section (alias, single version, py38, cpu/ubuntu20.04, 26 registries). Tests: tests/unit/sagemaker/image_uris/test_graviton.py (test_graviton_pytorch, test_graviton_tensorflow), graviton_framework_uri in expected_uris.py, and the two version fixtures in tests/conftest.py. Results: both new tests pass; test_dlc_frameworks.py plus test_graviton.py gave 504 passed; the other image URI modules gave 159 passed. Not verified: tests/unit/sagemaker/image_uris/test_retrieve.py and the jumpstart/ tests could not be collected because the shared venv lacks the mock package; I did not install it. Behavior diff against the base tree shows only the intended c6g routings for tensorflow 2.8.0 and pytorch 1.12.1. Nothing is committed. Black and flake8 are not in the venv, so formatting was done by hand.
